summary: Executed backend API regression (8 pytest cases) and frontend E2E flow for portal/login/dashboard/WA modal/upload on public URL. Core flows pass except CSV upload with required 'Nomor HP/WhatsApp' format.

critical.issue: Valid CSV using required column header 'Nomor HP/WhatsApp' is rejected with 422 (Kolom wajib tidak ditemukan).

integration_issues.issue: Frontend sends valid required-format CSV but backend rejects mapping; user sees toast error and dataset is not replaced.

action_items: Fix backend column alias mapping to accept normalized 'Nomor HP/WhatsApp' header (e.g., nomorhpwhatsapp).
Re-test upload from UI with the exact required columns after alias fix.
Populate /app/memory/test_credentials.md with the approved test account for future agents.
critical_code_review_comments: normalize_columns() aliases do not include normalized token for combined phone header ('nomorhpwhatsapp'), causing required user format rejection.
Test credential source-of-truth file is empty; auth testing currently depends on review-request credentials instead of repository memory.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed files created; sample endpoint and temporary upload payloads used.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use public URL from frontend/.env. Login, dashboard metrics, threshold filtering, WA modal, copy action, popup open, and contact status update all passed. Main blocker is CSV upload mapping for required 'Nomor HP/WhatsApp' header.
rca of the issue: RCA: backend normalize_columns() builds strict normalized tokens and alias list misses 'nomorhpwhatsapp'. Repro: login -> dashboard -> upload CSV with columns [Nama Pelanggan, Nomor HP/WhatsApp, Tanggal Transaksi, Total, Layanan] -> backend responds 422 with required-column error. Mitigation: add alias coverage for combined/slashed phone header tokens and keep existing backward-compatible aliases.
